game_title: Divide Or Floor – Pumice Pass Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split sulfur crystals evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split sulfur crystals evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round, molten golems strike the ember furnace, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ember furnace from molten golems in Pumice Pass: keep the share meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: share drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pumice Pass'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while share > 0.
